message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India (estimated)**  

| Item | Estimate |
|------|----------|
| **Base price (ex‑tax)** | ₹1.2 – 1.4 crore (USD ≈ $160 – $180 k) |
| **Import duty & GST** | 30 % + 18 % GST (≈ ₹45 – 55 lakhs) |
| **Total retail price** | **₹1.65 – 1.95 crore** (≈ $220 – $260 k) |

> **Why the estimate?**  
> • Tesla has not officially launched in India, so there is no published MSRP.  
> • The above figure is derived from the U.S. price of the Model S (≈ $160 – $180 k), plus Indian import duties (≈ 30 %) and GST (18 %).  
> • Additional costs such as registration, insurance, and local taxes could push the final price higher.  

**Bottom line:** If Tesla were to launch in India, you could expect the Model S to cost roughly **₹1.7 – 2 crore** (about **$230 – $270 k**). Keep an eye on official announcements—prices may vary once Tesla confirms its entry strategy.
